verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers AI Gateway's routing, caching, rate limiting, fallback, and logging features, but there is no mention of gateway-managed API keys, virtual keys, or any mechanism to mint scoped keys for teams/apps while hiding raw provider keys. AI Gateway appears to require passing provider API keys through directly (e.g., 'Switch providers by changing the model and apiKey parameters'), which is the opposite of key-management abstraction.
